text: No occupancy figure was reported for Sunday 22 Nov because no Reception or Operations report was seen. The latest figure is 91 of 183 rooms occupied (49.7%) on 21 Nov, 43 of them Rabdan.
Reports for 22 Nov were received from IT, the Flower shop and AJ1881. The Operations summary, Reception, Maintenance, HR & Accounts and Housekeeping reports were not seen.
IT fixed a TV issue in room 810 and installed the new internet connection, which still has to be configured. The Equal software is still slow, and 13 new CCTV cameras are still to be installed.

AJ1881 sold AED 526 from 15 covers (AED 252 food, AED 274 beverages), its highest day so far in this report. The flower shop recorded no sales; it made the IHC vase arrangement and the Sirius Holdings base arrangement, with both deliveries planned for 23 Nov, and prepared centrepieces for an upcoming event.

No Maintenance daily report was seen for 22 Nov. On the morning of 23 Nov Maintenance acknowledged the request for a full maintenance and equipment status report and will gather inspection reports, records and quotations from the RR Facility team and service providers.

AJ1881 again asked for approval to buy critical bar and kitchen supplies. Still awaiting decision: the elevator AMC, the facility management AMC proposal, room 710 FCU rewinding, the lobby partition concern, the MBG accounting and VAT proposal, the AJ1881 rename, the Pilates studio start and housekeeping, the final driver selection, and pending offer letters and visa processing.
